questions.question: When was metformin first prescribed, and at what dose?
Was the dose change from 500 mg twice daily to 2000 mg once daily documented as intentional and when?
What clinical rationale or indication was given for increasing metformin to 2000 mg?
Was the patient's renal function assessed before escalating metformin dose?
Has the patient reported any gastrointestinal side effects since starting or escalating metformin?
Was the metformin 2000 mg prescription confirmed in a signed clinician note or prescription record?
